matching: If a path matches more than one tier's globs, the most restrictive tier applies: human-required > review-required > auto-safe.

human-required.description: Agent CANNOT modify without a human. Prod-impacting or irreversible. Document for CODEOWNERS and agent instructions.

review-required.description: Agent can modify but the PR requires human approval, including agent instructions/skills.

auto-safe.description: Agent can freely modify. Auto-merge eligible.
